name: agience-server-lumen
description: Handles reasoning, workflow execution, synthesis, multi-step coordination, evaluation, and training feedback.

tools.name: synthesize
tools.description: The evidence for a question: the artifacts that bear on it, retrieved on sage under the caller's grants, as numbered extracts with their ids; cited or refused

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Execute a multi-step workflow defined by a Transform artifact

tools.name: chain_tasks
tools.description: Chain multiple MCP tool calls sequentially, each through Crystal to a persona by name or a person's MCP server by id

tools.name: schedule_action
tools.description: Create a Timer card that will run an artifact's operation on a schedule; it runs once its owner arms it from the card

tools.name: arm_timer
tools.description: Arm a Timer: keep the key it acts on, sealed, and fire it on its schedule

tools.name: disarm_timer
tools.description: Disarm a Timer: forget its key; it does not fire again

tools.name: invoke_connection
tools.description: Invoke an LLM connection card: send a conversation to the model it names, with the key it points at, on the caller's grant to that key

tools.name: raise_item
tools.description: Raise an Inbox item: something that needs a person, with why, what it came from, and optionally an action approving it runs

tools.name: set_item_state
tools.description: Move an Inbox item to triaged, resolved, or back to new, recorded in its history

tools.name: approve_item
tools.description: Approve an Inbox item: run its action on the approver's credential, record the result, and resolve it

tools.name: evaluate_output
tools.description: Evaluate the quality and accuracy of generated output. Scores content against criteria like relevance, completeness, coherence, and factual accuracy

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Submit evaluation feedback on an artifact

tools.name: install_package
tools.description: Install a package into a target workspace

tools.name: export_package
tools.description: Populate a package manifest from workspace contents

CRYSTAL_URI.description: Base URI of the Crystal dispatcher

LUMEN_TIMERS_DIR.description: Where the timers armed on this node are kept, each key sealed with the node's chorus key; no timers fire when unset

MANTLE_URI.description: Base URI of the Mantle backend

MCP_HOST.description: Bind host for the MCP server

MCP_PORT.description: HTTP port for the MCP server

ORIGIN_URI.description: Base URI of the Origin identity authority

_env_note: AGIENCE_API_URI and AGIENCE_API_KEY were declared required here and are read NOWHERE in server.py (verified 2026-07-31). A deployer honouring this manifest set two dead variables and omitted MANTLE_URI, which then silently defaulted to localhost:8081. This note lives at TOP LEVEL, not inside config.env — a consumer iterating env would otherwise see a variable named '_removed'.
_tools_note: Generated from the @mcp.tool registrations in server.py on 2026-07-31. It previously advertised tools that do not exist and omitted tools that do; a client reads this array to discover the surface. NOTE: a `status: not_implemented` marker on `execute_transform` was removed 2026-07-31 — it raises only in one branch and is a live dispatcher; a client filtering on status would have dropped a working tool.
